suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)

mutations.contract: Choosing Map after Classic draws the map again.
mutations.note: The switch can only ever land on Classic.
mutations.find:
if (!VA.isDagDrawing(id) || id === state.dagDrawing) return;
    state.dagDrawing = id;
mutations.replace:
if (!VA.isDagDrawing(id) || id === state.dagDrawing) return;
    state.dagDrawing = "classic"; /* mutated: Map cannot be chosen back */
